notes.title: Motorcycle Steering Adjustable - Update
notes.notes:
NEW : 
- Motorcycle steering is now adjustable

It's really hard to find the right setting for everyone.
Some people said it was too easy, others said it was too difficult.
So I've made the entire control system adjustable via a slider, so everyone can choose what they want.

notes.title: Content & Fix Update
notes.notes:
NEW: 
Tracks
- Beach track now has curves  
- New track sections added to the beach track

Options
- New sound options  
- New graphics options  
- Options menu is now also accessible in-game

Motorcycle Controls
- Controls revised  
- Motorcycle can now also be controlled with the arrow keys

Character
- Name is now saved for the entire session.  
- Selected gender is now saved for the entire session.

FIXES: 
Tracks
- No more falling through the ground on the test track  
- Spawn and route points have been fixed, which should reduce accidents

Weather and Time of Day
- Time of day and weather now persist after restarting a level  
- The last selected weather and time of day are now highlighted when reopening the list

Options
- All dropdown boxes now correctly apply their settings in the tables
